premises.text: Girls deserve better technology than toys designed for them that are inferior to those designed for boys
premises.evidence_span: This is awful and unfair. Girls are just as smart, and they deserve a lot better.

premises.text: Jewelbots are designed based on what girls want, focusing on friendship and communication
premises.evidence_span: We've talked to over 200 girls around the nation and asked them, what is important to you? And we've heard from them friendship, their friends, and communication.

premises.text: Jewelbots can communicate with each other without needing a mobile phone
premises.evidence_span: Jewelbots Patent Pending Mesh Network means Jewelbots is the first wearable device to communicate from device to device.

premises.text: Jewelbots allow girls to send secret messages in their own languages
premises.evidence_span: Jewelbots can be used to send messages, so girls can send each other secret messages in their own languages.

premises.text: Jewelbots are open source, allowing girls to program them creatively
premises.evidence_span: the best part is that Jewelbots are completely open source, so girls can code them to do whatever they imagine.

premises.text: Jewelbots are COPA compliant, ensuring safe communication among girls
premises.evidence_span: Jewelbots are also COPA compliant, so the girls can communicate with each other completely safely.

premises.text: Jewelbots can be customized with interchangeable charms and bands
premises.evidence_span: Jewelbots come with interchangeable charms and bands sold separately.

premises.text: Jewelbots have established licensing agreements with popular brands
premises.evidence_span: we're super excited to share with you our first Jewelbots licensing agreements. First, with the Cartoon Network, this year, Jewelbots is partnering with the Powerpuff Girls.

value.text: Girls feel empowered to become engineers through technology designed for them
value.evidence_span: If you're excited about a world where every girl feels empowered to become an engineer, come join us.

notes: Sales figures and promotional offers are excluded as traction.
